main_text.p: Aethiopica lingua affinis Hebraica.Hinc apparet Æthiopicam linguam in multis congruere cum Hebraicâ.
III. De eadé Sebast.Munsterus in Grammatica suâ Chaldaica hæc memoriæ prodidit:

Aethiopicæ editum PsalteriumEvulgatum est, inquit, ante paucos annos opera& diligentiâ Ioannis Potken Agrippinensis Psalterium quoddam, incognitis quidem & antehac non visis scriptum characteribus, incertaq; lingua, quam quidam Indianam putant, alii Chaldaicam vocant: ipse autem veram Chaldaicam afferit, nec ulli secus sentire permittit, præsertim Iudæorum au-scultatoribus. Deinde postquam alphabetum huius linguæ, & dictiones aliquot propofuit, subdit: Has literas & syllabas Bernhardus Breitenbachius in suo Itinerario, ubi de Abasinis sive Indianis scribit, confuso ordine posuit, figurâ minimè à nostris discrepante characteribus. Vbi obiter est notandum, duplicem esse Indiam: unam orientalem, quæ sciicet in Asia extremum occupat locum, India duplex.cuius jus

page.notes: Printed "jus" at the foot right is a catchword. The top list: "bohan" (first column, last word) and "Ofrael" are uncertain; the printed hyphen marks in the list lines are left as printed. "afferit" and "au-scultatoribus" are read from the line break, the long s being plain s. Left margin: three notes, the third placed beside the line "licet in Asia". No page number printed.
